<thought>To find the required template, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that, in the forward direction, breaks a halide (Cl) and forms a ketone on an aromatic ring with a new aromatic‑aryl C–C bond – i.e., a Friedel‑Crafts acylation. I will use acetophenone (CC(=O)c1ccccc1) as a representative product molecule for this search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"]
}</action_input>
